apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.2.2 — Song detail: the time strip is now a badge on the waveform bottom centre (web), the armed loop/group name shows as a tappable badge at the waveform top right (tap restarts the loop), the Follow/Reset zoom row is gone (auto-follow always on), and the page scrolls over the waveform with the playback section pinning to the top while the tab content scrolls beneath it.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Waveform badges + pinned playback section scrolling.
